recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining approved FHIR-38717 correction without reopening the already-correct parameter types or the separate FHIR-42703 parameter-name fix.
issue_request: FHIR-38717 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core NamingSystem change request from the Vocabulary work group. It requested correcting $translate-id output parameter types so targetIdentifier is string, targetIdentifier.period is Period, and the targetIdentifier.period description no longer says "perioid".
initial_application: The translate-id OperationDefinition was introduced in commit 25159ea161 with boolean output types and the misspelled period description. Commit 6157df25d1, explicitly for FHIR-38717, corrected targetIdentifier to string and targetIdentifier.period away from boolean, and commit dff8b8d97d later normalized the complex type code to Period, but the description typo persisted.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini and source/namingsystem/list-NamingSystem-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/NamingSystem-translate-id, so the edited XML is in current build scope. The 2022-12-05 Vocabulary tracker minutes list FHIR-38717 as resolved change required. FHIR-42703 is a same-operation parameter-name correction already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/namingsystem/operationdefinition-NamingSystem-translate-id.xml so the targetIdentifier.period documentation says "The period when the target identifier is valid." The already-correct targetIdentifier and targetIdentifier.period type values were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/namingsystem/operationdefinition-NamingSystem-translate-id.xml: corrected targetIdentifier.period documentation from "The perioid when the target identifier is valid." to "The period when the target identifier is valid."

related_jiras.note: A later same-operation issue corrected the neighboring targetIdentifier.preferred output parameter name and was already represented on the combined branch.
